o.text: Morphologically bişmək (“become cooked”) + -ir (“causative suffix”). Cognate with Turkish pişirmek (“to cook”), Kazakh пісіру (pisirüw, “to cook”), Tatar пешерү (peşerü, “to cook, to boil”), Uyghur پىشىرماق (pishirmaq, “to cook”).
From Old Anatolian Turkish [script needed] (doŋuz, “pig”), ultimately from Proto-Turkic *toŋuz (“pig”).
From Russian бригада (brigada), from French brigade, Italian brigata.
